facts.text: The hotel is in the Dolmabahçe area, overlooking the Bosphorus.
facts.excerpt: located in the prestigious Dolmabahçe area overlooking the Bosphorus

facts.text: Nobu Istanbul, the hotel's Nobu restaurant, serves Japanese-Peruvian cuisine.
Atölye's plates use produce grown in the hotel's own vegetable garden.
facts.excerpt: The fresh produce grown at The Ritz-Carlton, Istanbul’s own vegetable garden, brings a completely natural spirit to Atölye’s plates.

facts.text: Limoré is the hotel's Italian restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Limoré, which offers a menu rooted in the traditions of Italian cuisine

facts.text: The Nobu Suite has a private terrace with an ofuro soaking tub overlooking the Bosphorus.
facts.excerpt: The private terrace with Ofuro Tub offers sweeping Bosphorus views

facts.text: Room decor reflects Turkish culture and Ottoman times, with tulips and İznik tiles.
facts.excerpt: Decoration of rooms reflecting the Turkish culture and Ottoman times with Tulips and İznik tiles.

facts.text: The spa's hammam is modeled after the 16th-century Turkish baths of Roxelana and has a couple's suite.
facts.excerpt: hammam, modeled after the 16th-century Turkish baths of Roxelana and offering separate areas for ladies and gentlemen as well as a couple’s suite.

facts.text: The Roof is a rooftop terrace with an infinity pool and views of the Bosphorus.
facts.excerpt: Embraced by the lush greenery, with an infinity pool, The Roof at The Ritz-Carlton, Istanbul offers magical views of the Bosphorus

facts.text: The outdoor infinity pool is available during the summer period.
facts.excerpt: Our outdoor infinity pool is available during the summer period

facts.text: The Roof shows open-air cinema evenings every Tuesday from June to September.
facts.excerpt: At The Roof, guests can enjoy open-air cinema evenings every Tuesday from June to September

facts.text: The hotel offers a private Bosphorus yacht cruise that departs from Kabataş İskelesi.
facts.excerpt: Private yacht embarkation from Kabataş İskelesi

facts.text: The hotel runs a Ritz Kids program with tailored excursions to Istanbul attractions.
facts.excerpt: The hotel's Ritz Kids program, meanwhile, captures imaginations with tailored excursions to Istanbul’s most colorful attractions.

facts.text: Club Lounge food is presented five times daily.
facts.excerpt: Delight in an array of exquisite culinary offerings presented five times daily in our Club Lounge.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club.

facts.text: Club guests can have Turkish coffee brewed in hot sand every Wednesday.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Turkish coffee brewed in hot sand to perfection, every Wednesday.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel among its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026.
Atölye Restaurant is Michelin Guide listed.
facts.excerpt: Michelin Guide listed Atölye Restaurant offers its guests a unique gastronomic experience
